en.p: For a natural number $n$, two points $\mathrm{A}_n$, $\mathrm{B}_n$ on the curve $y=2^{x}$ satisfy the following conditions.

The circle whose center lies on the line $y=x$ and which passes through the two points $\mathrm{A}_n$, $\mathrm{B}_n$ meets the curve $y=\log_{2}x$ at two points; let $x_n$ be the larger of their $x$-coordinates. What is the value of $x_1+x_2+x_3$? [4 points]
